placesHint: Pick where the video starts (A) and where it ends (B). Use a country, a city or coordinates like 28.61, 77.21.
noMatch: No match. Try another spelling, or type coordinates such as 28.61, 77.21.
highlightHint: Colours each country you pick as a country. For a city, use the tick box under it.
caption: Title on the video (optional)
captionPlaceholder: For example: Delhi to New York
keepOpen: Keep this screen on and stay on this page while the video records. It takes as long as the video.
webmNote: This browser saves WebM video. It plays in Chrome, Edge and Firefox. If an app does not accept it, open this page in Chrome on a computer or a recent Android phone and save again, or convert the file.
noRecord: This browser cannot record video. You can still preview and save a picture. Try a recent Chrome, Edge, Safari or Firefox to make the video.
slowNote: Your device drew {fps} pictures a second, below 30. The video is the right length but may look less smooth. Choose 720p or a shorter length for a smoother result.
failed: The video could not be made. Try 720p or a shorter length, and keep this page open while it records.
sameStops: Start and end are the same place. Choose two different places.
fps: 30 frames a second. No watermark. Made on your device, nothing is uploaded.
smoothHint: Draws every frame one by one, so the video is smooth and sharp even on a slow phone. It can take longer than the video itself.
quickHint: Records while the globe plays, so it takes as long as the video. A slow phone may skip frames.
fpsSmooth: {fps} frames a second, every frame drawn. No watermark. Made on your device, nothing is uploaded.
keepOpenSmooth: Drawing every frame: {done}% done, about {left} seconds left. Keep this screen on and stay on this page.
smoothNote: Saved as an MP4 file with every frame drawn, at {fps} frames a second.
searchMore: Can't find it? Search more places
noMatchMore: Still no match. Check the spelling, or type coordinates such as 28.61, 77.21.
moreFailed: Could not load more places. Check your connection and try again.
moverNote: Train, car, bus and ship follow the straight curved line between the two places, not real tracks, roads or sea routes. The video is an illustration of the trip.
credit: Place names: GeoNames (CC BY 4.0) and Natural Earth. Borders of India as shown by India.
photoFailed: That picture could not be read. Try a JPG or PNG.
nightHint: Shades the side of the world facing away from the sun.
musicFailed: That audio file could not be read. Try an MP3, M4A or WAV file.
musicHint: Use music you have the right to use. It fades in and out and repeats if it is shorter than the video. Photos, logo and music are not saved between visits.
musicQuick: This browser cannot add music in Smooth mode, so a video with music is recorded in real time instead. Keep the page open and expect it to take as long as the video.

layouts.chain: Trip: A to B and on

layoutHints.chain: The globe follows one trip from the first place to the last, through any stops in between.
layoutHints.fan: Routes go from the first place to each of the others, such as where a business ships to. Up to 12 places. Places on the far side of the world show as the globe turns.
layoutHints.visited: No routes. Each place and its country light up one after another, such as countries you have visited. Up to 12 places.

placesHintMany: Pick the first place and the others. Use a country, a city or coordinates like 28.61, 77.21.
fourKHint: 4K needs a recent computer or phone and takes the longest. The file is large. Music needs a browser that can add sound to the video; if yours cannot, pick 1080p.
gpxBad: That file has no route or track points. Choose a .gpx file from your phone, watch or map app.
gpxDone: Used {{count}} places along your {{km}} km route. Names come from a nearby city, or from coordinates. The video shows an illustration, not your exact path.
placePicture: Use a picture of this place
placeAnother: Try another picture of this place
placeFill: Add place pictures to stops without a photo
placeNone: No free picture of {place} was found. Add your own photo instead.
placeSome: No free picture was found for {count} stop(s). Add your own photo to those.
placeCredit: Picture: {credit}. It is shown in the video.
faceNeeded: Add a photo to use it as the moving marker. Until then a dot is shown. Use a photo of yourself or of someone who agreed. It stays on your device.
cardsHint: A card is added only when it has text. The intro adds {intro} s before the globe and the ending adds {outro} s after it.
facts: Show trip facts on the ending card
factsHint: Places, countries and, for a trip, the straight-line distance, worked out from your stops.
